Welcome! I know you are a bit confused right now, but hear me out

Dialogues.Name: FX - 41
Dialogues.Line: I am FX - 41, and I will be your guide in this short platform experience.

Dialogues.Name: FX - 41
Dialogues.Line: This is the Lab, feel free to roam around.

Dialogues.Name: FX - 41
Dialogues.Line: When you think you are done, go through that Warp to go ahead.

Dialogues.Name: FX - 41
Dialogues.Line: You know collisions aren't a joke...

Dialogues.Name: FX - 41
Dialogues.Line: This is your capsule, you are the model PX-03

Dialogues.Name: FX - 41
Dialogues.Line: These are the older models but none of them managed to work properly

Dialogues.Name: FX - 41
Dialogues.Line: That's you! You've been designed thanks to a powerful 3D modeling tool called Blender!

Dialogues.Name: FX - 41
Dialogues.Line: While you roam around, you might stumble upon 3 warps, each one will challenge you with a different scenario

Dialogues.Name: FX - 41
Dialogues.Line: Just be careful to the enemies you will find around!

Dialogues.Name: FX - 41
Dialogues.Line: This is a Power Up! You can now DOUBLE JUMP!

Dialogues.Name: FX - 41
Dialogues.Line: Press the Jump button again while mid-air and you'll perform a DOUBLE JUMP!
